name: Counterparty Matching Criteria 6
definition: Compares information related to both sides of a counterparty.

ReportingCounterparty.name: Reporting Counterparty
ReportingCounterparty.definition: Specifies whether the information on the reporting counterparties are matching or not.

OtherCounterparty.name: Other Counterparty
OtherCounterparty.definition: Specifies whether the information on the other counterparties are matching or not.

DirectionOrSide.name: Direction Or Side
DirectionOrSide.definition: Specifies whether the information on the direction and side of leg are matching or not.

OneElementPresentRule.definition: At least one element must be present.
